The dish looks like a white paper plate about 18-20 cm across. It holds diced cooked chicken breast, roughly 25-30 pieces of about 2 cm each, piled in a small heap.

Each piece is about 2×2×1 cm, or roughly 4 cm³, which is about 4-5 g. At 28 pieces that comes to about 120 g. The pile looks a bit larger than that, so I'll estimate 110 g.

Cooked chicken breast has about 1.65 kcal/g, so 110 g is about 180 kcal. The chicken looks seasoned, with some browning and possibly a little sauce, so I'll round up to 190 kcal.
